blurb.text: A protected geographical indication (PGI) for Welsh wine, one of two regional PGIs in the United Kingdom. UK wine growing has long been held back by a cool climate, but warmer summers and better-suited grapes have increased investment.

sources.name: Wikipedia, Wine from the United Kingdom, the opening of the article
